title: MessageCatalog
description: UI messages for one locale (gameplan §11.2). Each message is MessageFormat 2 source; placeholders are bidi-isolated by the formatter, never by hand-inserted control characters.
$comment: v0 (Phase 0); provenance and source fingerprints in Phase 12 (ADR 0070). Pseudo-locales (en-XA, ar-XB) have no catalog file: they are derived from en at load time.

provenance.description: Who translated the catalog and whether a native reviewer signed it off (ADR 0070). Required in every catalog but the source (en); only a reviewed catalog ships.

description.description: Context for translators: where the message appears and what each variable holds. Required in the source (en) catalog by test.

source.description: In a translation: the fingerprint (sourceHash in @nabu/i18n) of the English message it was made from. When the English wording changes, the catalog check reports the translation as stale until a translator checks it and stamps it again. A change of meaning gets a new key instead.
